const (
	ProfileHost  = "host"
	ProfileStock = "stock"
)
const (
	DefaultUser       = vmdoc.DefaultUser
	DefaultUID        = vmdoc.DefaultUID
	DefaultSubIDStart = vmdoc.DefaultSubIDStart
)
const BaseTag = "gravel-hub"
var BasePackages = append(slices.Clone(vmdoc.BasePackages[:1]), "git", "jq", vmdoc.BasePackages[1])
func FirewallName(name string) string
func Render(p Params) (string, error)
func SSHSources(fw cloud.Firewall) []string
func Tag(name string) string
func ValidName(name string) error
func VolumeName(name string) string
type Action string
const (
	Unchanged Action = "unchanged"
	Created   Action = "created"
	Updated   Action = "updated"
	Deleted   Action = "deleted"
)
type DestroyOptions struct {
	DeleteVolume   bool
	DeleteFirewall bool
	DryRun         bool
}
type Kind string
const (
	KindFirewall Kind = "firewall"
	KindVolume   Kind = "volume"
	KindInstance Kind = "instance"
)
type Params struct {
	Profile  string
	Hostname string
	SSHKeys []string
	DataDevice    string
	ExtraPackages []string
	User       string
	UID        int
	SubIDStart int
	Stock *StockParams
}
type Result struct {
	Steps    []Step
	Instance *cloud.Instance
	Volume   *cloud.Volume
	Firewall *cloud.Firewall
	Recreated bool
}
func Create(ctx context.Context, p cloud.Provider, s Spec, dryRun bool) (Result, error)
func Status(ctx context.Context, p cloud.Provider, name string) (Result, error)
func (r Result) Changed() bool
type Spec struct {
	Name      string
	Region    string
	Size      string
	Image     string
	VolumeGiB int
	SSHKeyName   string
	SSHPublicKey string
	SSHFrom    []string
	Monitoring bool
	Tags []string
	Document Params
}
type Step struct {
	Kind     Kind
	Name     string
	Action   Action
	Detail   string
	Resource string
}
func AllowSSH(ctx context.Context, p cloud.Provider, name string, cidrs []string, dryRun bool) (Step, error)
func Destroy(ctx context.Context, p cloud.Provider, name string, o DestroyOptions) ([]Step, error)
type StockParams struct {
	PublicURL string
	OrgName string
	HubImage string
	BehindTunnel bool
}
